title: Exchange rights and vacancy priorities
abstract: arXiv:2611.27684v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many institutions let incumbents exchange positions while allocating announced vacancies by priority, withdrawing positions released by vacancy recipients. A policy specifies permitted exchanges, vacancy eligibility, and priorities. A strategy-proof, individually rational rule protecting exchange rights and vacancy priorities exists precisely for policies without conflict cycles. Restricting protection to first choices does not enlarge this class. We introduce the propose-and-trade rule, which satisfies these properties and selects the applicant-optimal core allocation under every conflict-free policy. We identify when propose-and-trade is the unique strategy-proof, individually rational rule protecting first choices. These axioms characterize deferred acceptance and top trading cycles in their classic settings. Under a policy with a conflict cycle, propose-and-trade is manipulable but protects exchange rights and first-choice claims. Re

translated_abstract: 许多机构允许在任者在职位之间调换，同时按优先级分配公布的空缺职位，并收回由空缺接收者释放出来的职位。一项政策规定了允许的调换、空缺资格以及优先级。一种既满足策略防操纵又满足个体理性、并且保护调换权和空缺优先级的规则，恰好在没有冲突循环的政策下才存在。将保护范围限制为第一志愿并不会扩大这类政策的范围。我们提出了“提议-交易”规则，该规则满足上述性质，并且在每一个无冲突政策下都能选出申请者最优的核心分配。我们刻画了提议-交易规则何时是唯一同时满足策略防操纵、个体理性并保护第一志愿的规则。这些公理在经典环境中分别刻画了延迟接受机制和最优交易循环机制。在存在冲突循环的政策下，提议-交易规则是可被操纵的，但它仍能保护调换权和第一志愿的权利。
tldr: 本文提出“提议-交易”规则，证明了保护调换权与空缺优先级的策略防操纵且个体理性的规则恰好在无冲突循环的政策下存在，并在无冲突政策下选出申请者最优的核心分配。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the propose-and-trade rule, proving that strategy-proof, individually rational rules protecting exchange rights and vacancy priorities exist precisely for policies without conflict cycles, and that propose-and-trade selects the applicant-optimal core allocation under every conflict-free policy.
